title: A Seventh Agent Now Fact-Checks Every Script | vitalii.no
description:
After an external review of a finished explainer film, factual slips were still reaching the screen — even though two earlier AI passes, the scriptwriter and the literary editor, had already read the script. Catching a wrong fact only after render meant the mistake had already cost rendering time and tokens, with no step whose single job was to check whether a claim was actually true.

I added a seventh agent — a science reviewer — as a third AI run inside the existing scripting stage, right after the literary-editor pass. It runs a gate_review: the same beats go back in, but the reviewer can only touch the spoken lines, and every change it makes gets written to a review_notes.json file that the director agent reads before planning a single shot.

The review stays scoped to facts and wording, not structure — it can't add or remove a beat, only correct what's actually wrong in them. Every script now gets a fact-check pass with a visible paper trail before a single frame gets planned.
